# Thermal Profile Phases:
#   [Phase 1] Cold Baseline (~18-19 °C) — System idle / ambient

#   [Phase 3] Mid-Range Operation (~20-22 °C) — Sustained compute load
#   [Phase 4] Late Profile (~various) — Dynamic workload variation
# ==============================================================================
